value.title: On my ballot
value.cantFileResidency: You can't file for this race. It serves {required}, and your address is in {actual}.
value.cantFileAge: You can't file for this race yet. The age to file is {required}, and you are {actual}.
value.cantFile: You can't file for this race.

refusal.not-your-office: You can't run for this office.
refusal.window-not-open: Filing for this race hasn't opened yet.
refusal.window-closed: Filing for this race has closed.

value.noBallot: No local election is on the calendar

not_in_game: A filing fee: the game takes none (owner ruling Nov 15, 'Remove the filing fee for now').
Turnout for any race, and the registered voters of the wider electorate: the roll above counts the people the town's own roll holds; the game keeps no past turnout for these races.
Votes for any race before the start: a seat's past election keeps only its date, its winner and the winner's share (offices.terms .elected).
The losing candidates of a past race: the records keep the winner only.
The hours the clerk's counter is open.
Where to drive to the filing office: a filing office is named, not placed.
